📖 How to use

  1. Enter the keyword or phrase you want to measure.
  2. Paste your article text, or enter a page URL and click Fetch & Load Text.
  3. Click Analyze to compute the real density statistics.
  4. Review the top-10 word frequency table for optimization ideas.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is keyword density?

The percentage of times a keyword appears relative to the total word count of the text.

What is a good keyword density?

Around 1–2% is generally considered natural. Stuffing keywords can hurt rankings instead of helping.

Why did the URL fetch fail?

Most websites block cross-origin fetching (CORS). When that happens, copy the page text and paste it into the text box instead.
